absent: Valid values and semantics of program type, attach type and map type enumerations.
Layout and lifecycle of type record, field descriptor, type object, map operations and program objects.
Assignment and reclamation protocol for owner pointer, reference counts and choice between work and callback teardown.
Meaning and transition rules for bypass, frozen, exclusive hash, cookie, extra word and per CPU element count.
Device offload registration, device lifetime and error handling of device operations.
Real arena allocation behavior and interpretation of sleepability, node and flag parameters.

findings.text: Owner descriptor records the program classification, whether just in time compilation applied, whether fragment handling is enabled, whether sleeping is allowed, a per storage type cookie table, an optional prototype for the attach function, and the expected attach classification. It is referenced from a map and characterizes the creator constraints.

Map identity and sizing state comprises a digest, an operations table pointer, optional inner map metadata, an optional security blob, a type tag, key and value widths, capacity, a per type extra word, flags, numeric identifier, human readable name, NUMA hint, BTF type identifiers plus BTF handle, and an optional memory accounting object. Sizing and BTF fields drive value handling and display decisions.

Map lifetime and synchronization state comprises a freeze mutex, atomic reference and user and write and sleepable counters, a union serving either as deferred free work storage or as deferred free callback storage, a spinlock plus owner pointer, bypass and frozen and deferred free mode flags, a per CPU element count, a write once cookie, and an exclusive program hash string. The union arms only one reclamation mechanism at a time.

Offload layout embeds a full generic map at its start and adds a network device pointer, a device operations pointer, opaque device private state, and linkage for an offload list. The device operations table offers key iteration plus element lookup, update and removal, each receiving the offloaded map plus caller buffers, with update also receiving control flags.

Helper prototype describes a five word integer calling convention returning a word, with flags for license restriction, packet access, sleeping possibility and restricted register clobbering, a return classification, per argument classifications available both by position and as an indexed array, companion per argument type identities or fixed sizes sharing storage through unions, an optional return type identity, and a predicate authorizing use by a given program.

Base type geometry uses eight low bits for the base value. The base limit is two raised to that width. Higher bits carry orthogonal modifiers. A combined provenance mask aggregates the six dynamic pointer source variants. A computed overall limit spans all defined flag bits so related enumerations can reserve sufficient width.

Helper arity allows up to twelve logical arguments with at most five passed in registers. Access direction uses one for read and two for write. Argument and return vocabularies terminate with limit sentinels derived from the overall type limit so the enumerations remain wide enough for combined flag values.

Freeze mutex serializes transitions of frozen state and associated write once fields. Owner spinlock serializes access to the owner pointer. Reference, user, write and sleepable accounting use atomic semantics so they remain safe without holding those locks, while per CPU element counts distribute update pressure.

Frozen and cookie state are write once after publication. The work versus callback union holds at most one pending reclamation role. Null or error encoded records are treated as absence and yield safe neutral outcomes rather than faults. Selective copy and zero preserve special field storage, and dedicated swap affects only user pointer fields.

A map moves from initialization with cleared counters through active use with elevated references, an optional freeze that permanently write protects it, and deferred destruction via either a grace period callback or multi grace period work. Bypass and exclusive hash and cookie capture creation time policy that persists unchanged into teardown.

Field metadata queries translate a special field kind into a stable short label and into storage width and alignment requirements. Pointer like kinds share a word sized representation while locking, timing, queueing, list, tree and count kinds each report host requirements of their own structure. Unrecognized kinds emit a one time warning and return neutral fallbacks.

Record predicates test for presence of a field kind through a mask and assess interrupt safety. A small safe subset covering locks, timers, queueing, task work, unreferenced kernel pointers and reference counts is accepted, while any other kind present marks the record unsafe. Null or error encoded records are treated as empty and never fault.

Object initialization clears the target extent and then applies kind specific setup such as setting a count to one or preparing list and tree linkage, leaving other kinds cleared. Initialization over a whole record applies this per field at its recorded offset and extent, and map value initialization delegates to the map record. Null or error records cause an immediate no operation.

Value transfer helpers preserve special field storage by copying or clearing only gaps between recorded special extents with checked primitives. Without a usable record they fall back to whole extent copy or clear. A long copy variant rounds the extent to word granularity and copies by machine words, while dedicated swap exchanges only user pointer fields between two objects and does nothing when none exist.

A race annotation evaluates an expression with checking disabled and returns its value. Fortified memory macros add object size bounds to plain operations. Error pointer detection treats null plus near top of address range encodings as failures, and a conditional warning abstraction either warns once or enforces compile time validity depending on build configuration.

Offload and capability predicates expose container retrieval from a generic map to its enclosing offloaded form, neutrality limited to the perf event array type, sequence display support requiring both a value type identity and a display callback, and detection of timer or queueing or task work fields indicating internal structures needing special handling.

Arena page helpers in this configuration are inert placeholders. Both sleepable and non sleepable allocation variants always report failure without reserving memory, and the non sleepable free variant performs no action. Signatures retain map, address, count, node and flag parameters for interface compatibility.

Type modifier vocabulary provides orthogonal higher bit flags for nullability, read only use, reservation, user memory, per CPU memory, release, trust, initialization, allocation, read copy update protection, non owning reference, dynamic pointer provenance, alignment and write intent, with sentinels marking the highest defined flag so limits can be derived. Argument and return vocabularies enumerate memory, map, context, scalar, socket, type identity, dynamic pointer, timer, lock and function roles, plus combined qualified variants formed with modifiers.

Two cross component contracts are exposed. The device operations table lets a driver supply key iteration and element access for an offloaded map. The helper prototype lets verification and code generation layers exchange calling convention, type expectations, size or type constraints and authorization for each helper, with register and memory properties conveyed through the shared type vocabulary.

Selective transfer that skips special extents can surprise callers expecting full duplication, since destinations retain prior special state unless explicitly initialized or swapped. Unknown field kinds trigger a one time warning and yield neutral metadata that must not be treated as success. Suppressed race checking around word copies hides intentional races from analysis and must remain confined to those helpers.

Reusing one storage word for either deferred work or grace period callback requires strict phase discipline to avoid corrupting the pending mechanism. Write once fields must not change after publication, and freeze transitions need mutex protection. Display support must check both type identity and callback presence before use, and offload neutrality must not be assumed for other map types.
